_comment: The five playable races. Names are placeholders (see docs/MASTER_DESIGN.md section 11). 'prices' multiplies the price of some goods on that race's planets. 'illegal_goods' are banned on all of the race's planets, whatever the government. 'manufacturing' changes ships and equipment made by the race: price, weight, how fast they wear, and hull armor (Veyari: best and priciest; Skarn: cheap but wear fast; Gorruk: heavy and tough). 'personality' (0-1) sets how their pilots answer hails: 'greed' (take bribes), 'courage' (resist threats and demands), 'helpful' (join your fights, share news).

races.name: Lumari
races.description: Brilliant, frail scientists allied with the Veyari.

races.name: Skarn
races.description: Cunning smugglers who work for whoever pays.

races.name: Gorruk
races.description: Massive warriors who live for honor and glory.
